newsitem.title: LEBANON: Syrians say Lebanon blast was accidental.
newsitem.headline: Syrians say Lebanon blast was accidental.

text.p: A small blast on Wednesday near a centre for Syrian army intelligence in northern Lebanon was accidental not the result of a bomb attack, a Syrian military spokesman in Lebanon said on Thursday.

The spokesman for Syrian forces stationed in Lebanon said in a statement that the blast was caused by a detonator that accidentally went off as some rubbish was being burnt near the centre in the northern port city of Tripoli.

Lebanese security sources said on Wednesday that a small bomb exploded in a lemon grove some 20 metres (yards) from the centre for Syrian army intelligence in the northern city of Tripoli, causing little damage and no casualties.

"The reports carried by some media that a sabotage attack targeted one of the military centres in Tripoli is not correct," the Syrian spokesman said in the statement carried by Beirut's official National News Agency (NNA).
Damascus is Beirut's main power broker with some 35,000 troops in Lebanon.
